chunks: Everything in it that is from Abū al-Ḥusayn Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar al-Asadī—may Allah be pleased with him—I have narrated from ʿAlī ibn Aḥmad ibn Mūsā; and Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad al-Sinānī; and al-Ḥusayn ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Aḥmad ibn Hishām al-Muʾaddib—may Allah be pleased with them—from Abū al-Ḥusayn Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar al-Asadī al-Kūfī—may Allah be pleased with him.

key_terms.أَبِي الْحُسَيْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَر: A named transmitter from whom reports are narrated
key_terms.الْكُوفِيِّ: A nisbah identifying him as being from Kūfah
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicating direct narration by the compiler

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Abū al-Ḥusayn Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar al-Asadī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Abū al-Ḥusayn Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar al-Asadī. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission, which is essential in hadith preservation and authentication within Shia scholarly tradition.
